items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: I certainly remember Larry Shields, but that was in the later years.

ctx.x: For instance, if you played those records, did you know who they were?

Not really. I can't remember any individuals. The name it seems to me I remember more than anybody else... I certainly remember Larry Shields, but that was in the later years. I don't remember hearing them. I remember hearing that Original Dixieland Band maybe in 1915, but I don't remember picking out any individual guys.

Well, the Victor records, when they first came out, never listed the personnel on there. Did it occur to you that they might have been a band from the North, or could you have told that they were a band from the South by just listening to the records?
